component.name: ocapi
component.summary: A desktop chat client for local and cloud LLM inference backends

description.p: ocapi is a desktop chat client for agentic work. It talks to local inference servers (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) and cloud APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral AI, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint), locally or on remote machines.

Features include streaming responses over Server-Sent Events, file attachments with PDF/OCR/document text extraction, and MCP (Model Context Protocol) server integration for tools, resources and prompts.
